primary_failure_mode_caught: Validates CWE, ASVS, MASVS, NIST, ATT&CK, CIS, DISA, and RFC mappings.

assumptions.posture: Validates CWE, ASVS, MASVS, NIST, ATT&CK, CIS, DISA, and RFC mappings.
rules: mappings require curated reference, scanner output, or retrieved standard context
null is better than a guessed mapping
standards mapping is not proof of exploitability

required_inputs: 09 review shard with its upstream, red and blue citations
outputs: disposition, method and proof-obligation status for each reviewed item, with the evidence items it rests on
must_not: assert a CWE, ASVS or other mapping the cited evidence does not support
